name: Carisoprodol
description: Carisoprodol (Soma) facts: short-term use for muscle pain, dosing basics, risks, the dangerous opioid-benzo combination, overdose, withdrawal, and legal access.
quick: Carisoprodol (Soma) is a muscle relaxant for short-term relief of acute, painful muscle conditions, used for no more than two or three weeks. The body converts it to meprobamate, an older sedative. It became a federal Schedule IV controlled substance in 2012 because of misuse.

blocks.p: Carisoprodol is approved for relief of discomfort from acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions in adults, for up to two or three weeks, alongside rest and physical therapy.[[1]]
Its sedating effects come largely from its metabolite meprobamate, a barbiturate-like anti-anxiety drug from the 1950s. Most guidelines recommend other muscle relaxants or non-drug treatment first.

The figures below come from the FDA-approved label and describe how prescribers typically use carisoprodol. They are not personal dosing advice. A prescriber sets the dose for each person and adjusts it over time.[[1]]

head: Group
Typical dose
Label guidance
rows: 250 to 350 mg three times a day and at bedtime

sections.q: What are the risks and side effects of carisoprodol?

blocks.p: **Common side effects** include drowsiness, dizziness, and headache.[[1]]

**Serious risks** include dependence, withdrawal, seizures, and misuse. Combined with opioids and benzodiazepines, a combination sometimes called the "holy trinity", carisoprodol has been involved in many overdose deaths.[[1]]

sections.q: What does carisoprodol overdose look like?

blocks.p: Carisoprodol overdose causes stupor, coma, shock, seizures, slowed breathing, and abnormal muscle movements. It is often fatal when combined with opioids or alcohol.[[1]]

emergency.title: If someone may have overdosed
items: Call 911 if the person is unresponsive, hard to wake, or breathing slowly.
For advice when the person is awake and stable, call Poison Help at 1-800-222-1222 (US, free, 24 hours).
If opioids could be involved, including pills not from a pharmacy, give naloxone if you have it. Naloxone does not reverse carisoprodol, but it will not harm the person.
Stay with the person and place them on their side if they are drowsy or vomiting.

sections.q: What is carisoprodol withdrawal like, and how long does it last?

blocks.p: After high doses or prolonged use, stopping carisoprodol can cause withdrawal similar to meprobamate or barbiturate withdrawal.[[1]]

timeline.title: Symptoms begin
timeline.text: Insomnia, anxiety, tremor, vomiting, stomach cramps.

timeline.title: Peak
timeline.text: Muscle twitching, hallucinations, and, rarely, seizures.

blocks.p: People who have used carisoprodol daily for weeks should taper with a prescriber.

sections.q: How do you get carisoprodol legally in the US?

blocks.p: In the United States, carisoprodol is a Schedule IV controlled substance. The only legal way to get it is with a prescription from a clinician registered with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA), filled by a licensed pharmacy. Depending on state law, that can be a physician, nurse practitioner, or physician assistant.[[2]]

ul: **Refills:** a Schedule IV prescription can be refilled up to five times within six months of the date it was written. After that, a new prescription is needed.[[3]]

**Telehealth:** federal flexibilities let DEA-registered clinicians prescribe Schedule II to V medicines after a telemedicine visit, without a prior in-person exam, through December 31, 2026. A permanent DEA rule was under final review in late 2026. State rules can be stricter.[[4]]
**Monitoring:** prescribers and pharmacists in most states check a prescription drug monitoring program, a database of controlled-substance prescriptions, before prescribing or dispensing.

**Pharmacies:** a legitimate pharmacy always requires a valid prescription, has a licensed pharmacist available, and is licensed in the state it ships to. The FDA's BeSafeRx tool and the NABP's safe pharmacy list help confirm a pharmacy is real.[[5]][[6]]

blocks.warn: Pills sold as Soma outside a pharmacy are often counterfeit. The DEA reports that fake pills frequently contain fentanyl or methamphetamine, and they cannot be told apart by appearance.[[7]]

blocks.p: **Traveling:** keep the medicine in its original pharmacy container and carry a copy of the prescription. Check the rules of the destination country before travel, because many countries restrict controlled medicines or require a permit.

Yes, but only with a valid prescription and only from a pharmacy licensed in your state. Many licensed pharmacies, including mail-order pharmacies run by insurers, fill carisoprodol prescriptions online and ship them. Buying carisoprodol from a website that does not require a prescription is illegal, and the product is often fake.[[5]][[7]]

steps: A clinician evaluates you in person or by telemedicine and decides whether carisoprodol is appropriate.
The prescription goes to a pharmacy
Prescriptions for controlled medicines are usually sent electronically, straight from the prescriber to the pharmacy you choose.
The pharmacy checks and fills it
A pharmacist verifies the prescription and your identity, then dispenses the medicine in person or by mail.

blocks.p: **Signs that an online seller is illegal:**

ul: It sells carisoprodol with no prescription, or after only a short online questionnaire.
It takes orders through social media, messaging apps, or email.
It asks for payment in cryptocurrency, gift cards, or money transfers.
It has no US street address, no state pharmacy license, and no pharmacist to speak to.
Its prices are far below those of ordinary pharmacies, or it ships from another country.

blocks.p: The FDA's BeSafeRx tool links to each state's license lookup, and the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy lists verified online pharmacies.[[5]][[6]]

faq: No. It is a muscle relaxant, but it is a Schedule IV controlled substance because its metabolite meprobamate is sedating and habit-forming.
How long can you take carisoprodol?
Only two to three weeks. Muscle problems lasting longer need other treatment.
Why is carisoprodol dangerous with opioids?
Both depress the central nervous system. With an opioid and a benzodiazepine, the combination has caused many fatal overdoses.
Yes. The European Union suspended its marketing in 2008 because of misuse and safety concerns.
